watermark: Demonstration · public data plus illustrative internal data · not IndusInd Bank MIS
footer: Every action is a recommendation routed to its owner; LisN does not execute, authorise or decide. Designed to run inside the bank, on the bank's approved models. Public figures from bank and peer disclosures as of a date pending verification; internal figures illustrative until discovery. Data frozen 2 Oct 2026, 18:00 IST.
pulse_caption: Public voice skews to people who post. Counts, not incidence. Inside figures illustrative until discovery.
sensitivity_footer: Not a forecast. Not additive across cards.

defs.received: Complaints received in the window, as an index: Q1 weekly average = 100. Counts are withheld until the bank's FY25 complaint disclosure sets the scale.
defs.states: Of complaints received in the window, the share resolved, still open, or waiting on the customer at the window end. The three add to 100%.
defs.over_30: Complaints with no final reply after 30 days, as a share of pending complaints at the window end.
defs.escalated: Share of the window's complaints escalated to a grievance desk.
defs.io: Share of the window's complaints referred to the Internal Ombudsman. Every rejection is reviewed there first.
defs.escalation_language: Share of the window's complaints whose text names the RBI, the Ombudsman or a court.
defs.contacts: All customer contacts, as an index (Q1 weekly average = 100). Negative share: contacts with a negative tone. Complaints are a subset.
defs.channels: Share of the window's complaints by channel, with each channel's state at the window end.
defs.ombudsman: Shares of pending complaints at the window end. On the brink: 20 to 30 days, no final reply. Eligible: over 30 days, no final reply. Unhappy with the reply: replied, and the customer came back within 90 days. Awaiting IO review: a rejection the Internal Ombudsman has not yet reviewed. At risk: any of these. RB-IOS timelines: confirm with the bank.
defs.risk_by_business: Share of at-risk pending complaints, by business.
defs.outflow: Savings outflows, as an index: Q1 weekly average = 100. No balance is shown after 30 Jun 2026.
defs.closures: Savings account closures, as an index: Q1 weekly average = 100.
defs.sensitivity: Arithmetic on the period-end base. Not a forecast. Not additive across cards.
defs.heatmap: Share of the window's savings outflow by balance slab, region and branch type. Your data shows the real split.
defs.premature: Term deposits withdrawn before maturity, as an index: Q1 weekly average = 100.
defs.new_money: New savings accounts, as an index: Q1 weekly average = 100.
defs.pattern: What the Internal Ombudsman's quarterly complaint-pattern analysis would cover this quarter: shares of the window's complaints.
defs.closure_risk: Card accounts flagged at risk of closure, as an index: Q1 weekly average = 100. Aggregate only; no customer list.
defs.l2_items: Public items in the window: INDIE reviews on Google Play and the App Store, and consumercomplaints.in. X and Reddit wait on a licence decision. Counts, not incidence.
defs.escalation_public: Public items naming the RBI, the Ombudsman, a court or cyber crime.
defs.responded: Share of Google Play reviews with a reply from the bank (Play returns the reply). Other sources do not return replies.
defs.security_trend: Weekly share of app items saying the app blocks the phone as unsafe (threat detected, secure operating system, screen reader). Shares, not counts: Play reviews start mid-window.
defs.weekly: Received and closed in the week: indices on the Q1 weekly intake (= 100). Pending: complaints with no final reply at the week end, in weeks of Q1 intake. Over 30: share of pending with no final reply after 30 days. Rejected, reopened and to the IO: shares of the week's final replies.

l2_not_enough: Not enough public items this window
